computer.text: Ikhompyutha ngaphakathi kwale thebhu, ehlukaniswe nale divayisi: iboleka iphrosesa nenkumbulo, futhi ayifinyeleli neze okunye.
computer.lede: Ikhompyutha kule thebhu, ehlukile kule divayisi: isebenza ngamafayela inikezwa wona ngumsebenzi, futhi ifinyelela kuphela amasayithi owavumelayo.
computer.engine.pyodide.text: Umsebenzi wedatha, nge-pandas, NumPy ne-Matplotlib: cishe {size} okokuqala
computer.internet.text: Lokho ikhompyutha engakufinyelela. Ayilutholi neze ama-cookie akho noma okhiye bakho.
computer.internet.never: Kuvaliwe, njengoba Izimvume zithi Neze ku-Ukusebenzisa i-inthanethi.
computer.sites.none: Awekho okwamanje: isayithi ngayinye entsha ibuzwa kuqala.
computer.registries.text: Okwesibuko, ikhophi yale mithombo inhlangano yakho engayiqhuba. Ukhiye uhlala kule divayisi futhi uya ekhelini lawo kuphela.
computer.time: Isikhathi eside kakhulu umyalo ongaqhubeka ngaso
computer.time.text: Ukukushintsha kuqala kabusha ikhompyutha, okumisa lokho ekuqalisayo.
computer.limits.text: Okwemiyalo emide, nokwesibuko emsebenzini. Abantu abaningi abakushintshi neze lokhu.
computer.workspace.text: Amafayela ikhompyutha esebenza ngawo uma umsebenzi ungenayo ifolda.
computer.workspace.confirm: Susa wonke amafayela endaweni yokusebenza yale phrojekthi?
computer.workspace.kept: Amafayela aboniswe ngaphansi kwempendulo ahlala lapho.
computer.reach.question: Vumela ikhompyutha ifinyelele isayithi {site}?
computer.relay.text: Ikheli lesidlulisi, lamasayithi enqaba izicelo ezivela kwamanye amasayithi. Lishiye lingenalutho ukuze uhambe ngqo, nge-proxy yale divayisi uqobo.
computer.terminal.text: Qalisa imiyalo kukhompyutha ngokwakho, kumafayela afanayo nawengxoxo. Umlayezo wakho olandelayo usho lokho okuqalisile. {keys} iyivula noma kuphi.
computer.terminal.refused: Akugcinwanga, ngoba kushintshwe kwenye indawo okwamanje: {files}
